events.title: iPod's 25th Anniversary
events.blurb: Apple released the first iPod on this day in 2001, revolutionising portable music.

angles.name: iPod Impact
angles.copy: Remember when the iPod first dropped? It wasn't just a music player, it was a cultural reset. What was the first album you loaded onto yours?

events.title: James Bond Day
events.blurb: James Bond Day celebrates the premiere of the first 007 film, 'Dr. No', in 1962.

angles.name: Favourite Bond
angles.copy: It's James Bond Day! From the gadgets to the theme tunes, what's your ultimate 007 moment?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: The legendary Beatles co-founder, born in Liverpool in 1940, would have celebrated his 86th birthday today.

angles.name: Lennon Legacy
angles.copy: Remembering John Lennon on what would have been his 86th birthday. His music and message continue to resonate worldwide. What's your favourite Lennon track?

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: The iconic British comedian and actor, known for Monty Python and Fawlty Towers, celebrates his 87th birthday.

angles.name: Cleese Comedy
angles.copy: Happy 87th birthday to the brilliant John Cleese! From 'Ministry of Silly Walks' to Basil Fawlty, what's your favourite Cleese comedy moment?

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their ninth studio album, officially titled 'The Beatles,' commonly known as the 'White Album', in 1968.

angles.name: White Album Tracks
angles.copy: 58 years ago, The Beatles gave us the 'White Album'. A sprawling masterpiece – what are your standout tracks from this double LP?

events.title: Remembering Freddie Mercury
events.blurb: The world remembers Freddie Mercury, the legendary Queen frontman, who passed away in 1991.

angles.name: Freddie's Voice
angles.copy: 35 years since we lost the incomparable Freddie Mercury. His voice and stage presence remain unmatched. What's your favourite Queen anthem?

events.title: The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their sixth studio album, 'Rubber Soul,' in 1965.

angles.name: Rubber Soul Vibe
angles.copy: On this day in 1965, The Beatles dropped 'Rubber Soul'. Widely considered a turning point, what's your favourite track from this classic?

events.title: Remembering John Lennon
events.blurb: The world mourns the loss of John Lennon, who was tragically killed in 1980.

angles.name: Lennon's Peace
angles.copy: Remembering John Lennon, 46 years since his tragic passing. His message of peace continues to inspire. What's a Lennon lyric that resonates with you?

events.title: David Bowie would have been 80
events.blurb: The legendary British musician and cultural icon, born in 1947, would have celebrated his 80th birthday.

angles.name: Bowie's Influence
angles.copy: Remembering David Bowie on what would have been his 80th birthday. A true innovator who constantly pushed boundaries. Which Bowie era is your favourite?

events.title: Elvis Presley would have been 92
events.blurb: The King of Rock and Roll, born in Mississippi in 1935, would have celebrated his 92nd birthday.

angles.name: King of Rock
angles.copy: On what would have been his 92nd birthday, we're celebrating the one and only Elvis Presley. The King's legacy lives on! What's your top Elvis track?

events.title: Jimmy Page turns 83
events.blurb: The iconic Led Zeppelin guitarist and producer, born in Heston, Middlesex in 1944, celebrates his 83rd birthday.

angles.name: Guitar Legend
angles.copy: Happy 83rd birthday to the legendary Jimmy Page! From The Yardbirds to Led Zeppelin, his guitar work shaped rock history. What's your favourite Page riff?

events.title: Rod Stewart turns 82
events.blurb: The legendary British singer, known for hits like 'Maggie May' and 'Sailing', born in North London in 1945, celebrates his 82nd birthday.

angles.name: Rod's Hits
angles.copy: Happy 82nd birthday to Sir Rod Stewart! A career spanning decades and countless hits. What's the Rod song that always gets you singing?

events.title: Suggs turns 66
events.blurb: Graham McPherson, better known as Suggs, the charismatic frontman of Madness, born in Hastings in 1961, celebrates his 66th birthday.

angles.name: Madness Legend
angles.copy: Happy 66th birthday to the one and only Suggs! The voice of Madness, bringing us 'Our House' and so many more. What's your favourite Madness tune?

events.title: Paul Young turns 71
events.blurb: The British singer, famous for hits like 'Wherever I Lay My Hat (That's My Home)', born in Luton in 1956, celebrates his 71st birthday.

angles.name: Paul's Vocals
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 71st birthday to Paul Young! That smooth, soulful voice gave us some unforgettable 80s classics. Which one is your favourite?

events.title: Dolly Parton turns 81
events.blurb: The iconic American country music legend and businesswoman, born in Tennessee in 1946, celebrates her 81st birthday.

angles.name: Queen of Country
angles.copy: Happy 81st birthday to the one and only Dolly Parton! A true legend, songwriter, and businesswoman. What's your go-to Dolly track?

events.title: Gary Barlow turns 56
events.blurb: The Take That frontman and successful solo artist, born in Frodsham, Cheshire in 1971, celebrates his 56th birthday.

angles.name: Gary's Tunes
angles.copy: Happy 56th birthday to Gary Barlow! From Take That anthems to his solo hits, he's written some absolute belters. What's your favourite Gary Barlow song?

events.title: Billy Ocean turns 77
events.blurb: The Trinidadian-British singer, known for hits like 'Caribbean Queen', born in Fyzabad, Trinidad and Tobago in 1950, celebrates his 77th birthday.

angles.name: Billy's Vibes
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 77th birthday to the brilliant Billy Ocean! His smooth sound gave us so many timeless hits. Which one is your favourite?
